scope: Focused reinspection of an already catalogued repository and primary-literature assessment of a proposed neuromodulation experiment.
inspection_method: Shallow sparse checkout; selected documentation and code read, with current training protocol distinguished from historical baseline reviews.

inspected_files.inspection_focus: Current model status and distinction between fixed baseline and experimental v6.
Current stimulation protocol, memory targets, state persistence, and scientific limitations.
Selected candidate v2-v6 assumptions and failed visual and conditioning results.
Modulatory-cell mask, external stimulation, rate-driven plasticity, and state reset.
Selected rate-rule implementation, declared provenance, and parameter assumptions.
Modulatory delivery trace and absence of a generic receptor-specific target response.

boundaries: Dopamine-neuron stimulation is not a calibrated extracellular chemical exposure.
The experimental v6 pathway differs from the fixed default baseline.
Generic modulatory delivery traces do not implement target-specific octopamine or serotonin physiology.
Primary papers support specific assays; predictions about Doom performance remain hypotheses.
The literature search is focused rather than systematic or exhaustive.
